question: In a certain code language, TAPE is written as EPAT and LOVE is written as EVOL. How will NITIN be written in the same language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

TAPE is written as EPAT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f144e278ca05e4c9d2fa440376d099995849870777eed95e446f46f4464c6aaa.png] 

And

LOVE is written as EVOL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d3865905427a4894b7a84dcb637384d2b450efca1fc13d6bb97567ef43923af.png] 

Similarly,

'NITIN' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba097566dc751e129c167b58394c6d4a18f37eec5fe336496cede604f5a746ac.png] 

Hence, 'NITIN' is coded as "NITIN".
